payload.reframe_quote: What is unequal is not speed and not prominence: an instruction has an addressee, a verb and a deadline, and a correction has none of the three.
payload.note: The Local Commitment promised at event 0008 arrived through the same channel once the concept phase opened. A bounded object (a card: a public correction's source sentence on the front, the instruction 'copy the sentence onto the card by hand, take the card with you', the correction verbatim on the back) plus a checkable citation count run before any form was chosen. A second, competing concept proposed the same night was killed at the same session's own gate on its own author's pre-written death condition (an arithmetic error the conductor's verification had checked without checking the meaning); that kill is disclosed here rather than folded into the commitment quietly. One offer is named but explicitly not yet made: the physical realisation waits on a gate condition (the two sentences held verbatim) before it is described and asked for once.
